units.ENERGY action · day.grow.a: {el} brings Action, a push your chart welcomes. Your effort travels further than it did yesterday, while each task wants a little more of your drive.
units.ENERGY action · day.grow.b: {el} brings Action, more of an energy that serves your chart. Useful work turns up today, though the choice of where your effort goes is yours.
